title: compress.powerpacker.export result
description: The decoded file that would be written, and whether it was, beside the summary of the stream it came from.

offset.description: Byte offset the packed stream was read from.

packed_bytes.description: Bytes of packed input available from that offset.

decoded_sha256.description: Digest of the decoded bytes, so two recipes' output can be compared without holding either. The bytes themselves are the export's business.

declared_size.description: What a leading size field claimed, when the layout has one. A value that disagrees with `decoded_bytes` is reported as a COMPRESS_DECLARED_SIZE_MISMATCH warning rather than swallowed.
